chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated to us, he said: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Yahya informed us, he said: Abu Bakr ibn Nafi narrated to us, he said: Umayya ibn Khalid narrated to us, he said: Hammad ibn Salama narrated to us, he said: Ali ibn Zayd narrated to us, from Ali ibn al-Husayn, who said: I heard my father narrating from his father, the Commander of the Faithful, Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon them), that he said: I heard the Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family) saying:

O Ali, by He who split the grain and created the living being, indeed you are the best of creation after me. O Ali, you are my deputy and the Imam of my nation. Whoever obeys you has obeyed me, and whoever disobeys you has disobeyed me.

key_terms.أفضل الخليقة: The best of creation - supreme rank among all created beings
key_terms.إمام أمتي: Imam of my nation/community - the divinely appointed leader of the Muslim ummah
key_terms.فلق الحبة وبرأ النسمة: He who split the grain and created the living being - an oath formula invoking God as Creator
key_terms.وصيي: Wasi - my deputy/successor, the designated spiritual and temporal successor of the Prophet

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about Ali being his successor?
ai.summary: In this hadith, narrated through a chain going back through Imam Zayn al-Abidin and Imam Husayn to Imam Ali (peace be upon them all), the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) addresses Ali directly with an oath by God, declaring him the best of creation after the Prophet, his designated successor (wasi), and the Imam of the Muslim nation. This tradition was recorded in the teaching assemblies (amali) of Shaykh al-Saduq in 367 AH, during a period when Shia scholars were compiling such prophetic declarations to establish the doctrinal basis for Imamate.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. Muhammad narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. `Ali b. Yahya narrated to us. He said: Abu Bakr b. Nafi` narrated to us. He said: Umayya b. Khalid narrated to us. He said: Hamid b. Salama narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Zayd narrated to us from `Ali b. al-Husayn. He said: I heard my father narrate from his father Amir al-Mu’minin `Ali b. Abi Talib (as) narrate:  I heard the Messenger of Allah (s) say:
O `Ali! You are the deputy and the Imam of my Nation. Whoever obeys you has obeyed me, and whoever disobeys you has disobeyed me.
